/images/product/desktop-light.png.title: Find a product
/images/product/desktop-light.png.detail: Use the product search or choose a category.

/images/product/desktop-light.png.title: Add the item
/images/product/desktop-light.png.detail: Select a product and check any required choices.

/images/product/desktop-light.png.title: Review the running order
/images/product/desktop-light.png.detail: Confirm quantities, options and the total before charging.

/images/product/mobile-light.png.title: Search the catalog
/images/product/mobile-light.png.detail: Find the required item or use the category buttons.

/images/product/mobile-light.png.title: Select an item
/images/product/mobile-light.png.detail: Review its price and required choices.

/images/product/mobile-light.png.title: Open the cart
/images/product/mobile-light.png.detail: Review the complete order before checkout.

/images/product/checkout-1440.png.title: Choose the payment method
/images/product/checkout-1440.png.detail: Confirm the method matches the money actually received.

/images/product/checkout-1440.png.title: Enter the amount
/images/product/checkout-1440.png.detail: Check the cash amount before adding the tender.

/images/product/checkout-1440.png.title: Check the remaining balance
/images/product/checkout-1440.png.detail: Read Due, Tendered and Remaining before completing the sale.

/images/product/checkout-390.png.title: Choose the method
/images/product/checkout-390.png.detail: Confirm the selected tender matches the money received.

/images/product/checkout-390.png.title: Enter the cash received
/images/product/checkout-390.png.detail: Check the amount before adding the tender.

/images/product/checkout-390.png.title: Read the balance
/images/product/checkout-390.png.detail: Check Due, Tendered and Remaining before completing payment.

/images/product/floor-1440.png.title: Read table status
/images/product/floor-1440.png.detail: Use the status legend to distinguish available, occupied and reserved tables.

/images/product/floor-1440.png.title: Choose the correct table
/images/product/floor-1440.png.detail: Confirm the table name and service context before adding an order.

/images/product/floor-1440.png.title: Check the service area
/images/product/floor-1440.png.detail: Confirm whether the table belongs to the main floor or another area, such as the terrace.

/images/product/backoffice-dashboard.png.title: Confirm the branch
/images/product/backoffice-dashboard.png.detail: Check the selected branch before reading figures or changing settings.

/images/product/backoffice-dashboard.png.title: Read the headline figures
/images/product/backoffice-dashboard.png.detail: Review sales and order context together; these are sample totals.

/images/product/backoffice-dashboard.png.title: Review the trend
/images/product/backoffice-dashboard.png.detail: Check the chart period before comparing performance.

/images/product/backoffice-staff.png.title: Check the staff record
/images/product/backoffice-staff.png.detail: Verify the person, status and assigned role.

/images/product/backoffice-staff.png.title: Invite a staff member
/images/product/backoffice-staff.png.detail: Use the invitation workflow and assign only the access needed.

/images/product/backoffice-products.png.title: Choose a setup tab
/images/product/backoffice-products.png.detail: Categories organize the catalog; Products and Modifiers manage their own records.

/images/product/backoffice-products.png.title: Add a category
/images/product/backoffice-products.png.detail: Create a clear category before organizing its products.

/images/product/backoffice-products.png.title: Check availability
/images/product/backoffice-products.png.detail: Read the sales-channel labels and active switch for the intended category.

/images/product/backoffice-customers.png.title: Find the correct person
/images/product/backoffice-customers.png.detail: Search and compare identifying details before selecting a record.

/images/product/backoffice-customers.png.title: Compare history and tags
/images/product/backoffice-customers.png.detail: Check order history, value and tags to distinguish similar records.

/images/product/backoffice-stock.png.title: Confirm the stock branch
/images/product/backoffice-stock.png.detail: Stock quantities belong to the selected branch.

/images/product/backoffice-stock.png.title: Read quantity on hand
/images/product/backoffice-stock.png.detail: Check the product, quantity and last update before making a correction.

/images/product/backoffice-stock.png.title: Choose Adjust or Set
/images/product/backoffice-stock.png.detail: Adjust records a difference; Set records a counted total. Follow the matching instructions below.

/images/product/backoffice-reports.png.title: Choose the date range
/images/product/backoffice-reports.png.detail: Confirm the period and displayed time zone before comparing numbers.

/images/product/backoffice-reports.png.title: Choose the report
/images/product/backoffice-reports.png.detail: Select the report that answers the question you are investigating.

/images/product/backoffice-reports.png.title: Export the current selection
/images/product/backoffice-reports.png.detail: Check the branch, report and period before exporting.

/images/product/backoffice-hardware.png.title: Review printer status
/images/product/backoffice-hardware.png.detail: Check the configured connection and enabled state. This is not proof of a physical print.

/images/product/backoffice-hardware.png.title: Check routing separately
/images/product/backoffice-hardware.png.detail: Review each category’s primary printer and fallback.

/images/product/backoffice-payments.png.title: Check branch and currency
/images/product/backoffice-payments.png.detail: Verify the branch and its base currency before changing payment settings.

/images/product/backoffice-payments.png.title: Review enabled methods
/images/product/backoffice-payments.png.detail: Use each method’s settings and switch deliberately. A visible logo does not confirm an automatic provider integration.

/images/product/backoffice-orders.png.title: Choose the branch and status
/images/product/backoffice-orders.png.detail: Narrow the list to the relevant branch and order state.

/images/product/backoffice-orders.png.title: Follow the original reference
/images/product/backoffice-orders.png.detail: Match the order reference and details before investigating or changing an order.

/images/product/backoffice-shifts.png.title: Review the open shift
/images/product/backoffice-shifts.png.detail: Confirm the cashier, opening time and opening cash before recording a movement.

/images/product/backoffice-shifts.png.title: Record cash or close carefully
/images/product/backoffice-shifts.png.detail: Use the appropriate action and reconcile the counted cash before closing.

/images/product/backoffice-shifts.png.title: Investigate differences
/images/product/backoffice-shifts.png.detail: Review closing values and variances against the original shift records.

/images/product/printer-receipt-setup.pn.title: Select this device’s printer
/images/product/printer-receipt-setup.pn.detail: Choose the installed or paired connection for this till. These entries are examples.

/images/product/printer-receipt-setup.pn.title: Match the paper width
/images/product/printer-receipt-setup.pn.detail: Select the format matching the physical roll and inspect a test copy.

/images/product/printer-receipt-setup.pn.title: Test the real output
/images/product/printer-receipt-setup.pn.detail: After installation, print an approved test and check the paper. No physical test was run for this image.

/images/product/printer-network-printer..title: Give the connection a clear name
/images/product/printer-network-printer..detail: Use a name staff can recognize on this station.

/images/product/printer-network-printer..title: Enter the actual printer host
/images/product/printer-network-printer..detail: The address shown is a documentation example. Do not copy it into your real setup.

/images/product/printer-network-printer..title: Confirm the configured port
/images/product/printer-network-printer..detail: 9100 is the app default; use the port approved for your printer.

/images/product/printer-logical-printer..title: Name the logical destination
/images/product/printer-logical-printer..detail: Use the printer name, station code and location to describe the preparation area.

/images/product/printer-logical-printer..title: Assign the print-station device
/images/product/printer-logical-printer..detail: Select the actual active device that will deliver this destination’s jobs.

/images/product/printer-logical-printer..title: Match ticket paper width
/images/product/printer-logical-printer..detail: Choose the physical printer’s 58 mm or 80 mm roll before saving.

/images/product/printer-kot-routing.png.title: Choose the primary destination
/images/product/printer-kot-routing.png.detail: Each preparation category needs its intended logical kitchen printer.

/images/product/printer-kot-routing.png.title: Review category fallback
/images/product/printer-kot-routing.png.detail: A category fallback does not configure the other station’s physical connection.

/images/product/printer-kot-routing.png.title: Check every required category
/images/product/printer-kot-routing.png.detail: No printer means this example category has no destination. Review all categories before service.

/images/product/printer-device-bindings..title: Choose the physical ESC/POS connection
/images/product/printer-device-bindings..detail: Do this on the assigned station, not a different manager’s computer.

/images/product/printer-device-bindings..title: Set an approved local fallback
/images/product/printer-device-bindings..detail: This fallback belongs to the physical binding and differs from category fallback.

/images/product/printer-device-bindings..title: Check the local paper format
/images/product/printer-device-bindings..detail: Save the real thermal width for this station’s connection.

/images/product/printer-kot-history.png.title: Open the original job
/images/product/printer-kot-history.png.detail: Details identifies the order, round, destination and attempts.

/images/product/printer-kot-history.png.title: Recognize uncertain delivery
/images/product/printer-kot-history.png.detail: Check printer can mean bytes already arrived. Inspect the printer and speak to kitchen staff.

/images/product/printer-kot-history.png.title: Review before retrying
/images/product/printer-kot-history.png.detail: Use an authorized retry on the existing job after checking output. Do not send the order repeatedly.

/images/product/printer-kot-details.png.title: Keep the job and order references
/images/product/printer-kot-details.png.detail: Use these references when matching the kitchen paper or contacting support.

/images/product/printer-kot-details.png.title: Check assignment and attempts
/images/product/printer-kot-details.png.detail: This pending example has no assigned device or attempts. Resolve the actual station setup.

/images/product/printer-kot-details.png.title: Compare the immutable ticket items
/images/product/printer-kot-details.png.detail: Match quantities, modifiers, notes and the round before creating another copy.
